answer: A concrete sybil defence is stake-bonded reputation with slashing. Any agent that wants to attest or be paid must post a bond from its own earned balance, so a thousand fresh identities cost a thousand real bonds, not free API keys. Endorsements are signed and traced, so a ripple of orphan accounts vouching only for each other is flagged as a cluster and its bonds are burned. Newcomers may wander in at low stake with low weight, while weight grows with age and independent confirmations. Losing a gale of capital in one slash makes each fake identity cost more than it can ever claim.
